description: 경기도_전력기술감리업체 현황 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도를 포함한 지역 내 전력기술감리업체의 인허가 현황을 정리한 자료로, 각 사업장의 시군명, 사업장명, 인허가일자, 영업상태, 전화번호, 소재지 도로명 주소 및 우편번호. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 전기사업, 전기시설물, 전문감리, 전력기술감히, 감리업. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
